rationale: First-shot of the only classification-pretrained TSFM in the registry hit 1/7 wp avg_ann -10.6% — beats both baselines on avg_ann (random_topk -30%, rule_only -28%) and matches Toto2 default's W4 break. Score distribution is alive on W1 (thr=0.4 picks 23 trades vs thr=0.0's 33) but collapses to thr=0.0 across W2-W7; train mode should sweep target_length / dropout / channel_indices / pos_weight to recover within-date dispersion in W2/W6/W7 where the raw signal is alive but the WR floor is missed.
